blocks.text: Living coral instructions spread across the old route network as luminous surface growth.
Appearance: Separate original coral colonies grow from small to full size over 45 seconds. Polyps animate and shed individual angular grains with continuous rotation.
Care: Use the infection treatment listed in Care; cleaning supports recovery.
Story connection: A reef guide could use the bloom pattern to recover lost route arrows.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
